name: pi-boehsline
description: Boehsline ("bays-line"): the baseline for pi. Extensions, skills, prompts, and opinionated defaults in one package.
author: Eric Boehs
//peerDependenciesMeta: Optional so pi's git installer (a plain npm install in the clone) does not pull a copy of pi in behind it. pi supplies these at runtime; CI installs them only to typecheck.

pi.//: Explicit globs: each extension is a folder with index.ts and a README.md; lib/ holds imported modules, not extensions. Opt-in extensions are declared like the rest and gate themselves (lib/opt-in.ts), because pi settings filters can only narrow what a manifest declares. packages/* are git subtrees kept verbatim (so `git subtree pull` stays clean), except packages/scheduler, developed here since pi-scheduler was archived; list their entry files here instead of restructuring them.
pi.//skills: agent-link's pi-agent-link skill only: its grok-bot-pi-link skill drives a personal phone-to-Grok bridge (contrib/grok-bot) and would only confuse other installs.

//dependencies: Runtime deps for extensions/web/fetch (web_fetch). pi installs root dependencies only, so nested package.json files don't count.
